name: field-verification-openapi-foundation
objective: Re-pin branch A, remove contract/OpenAPI blockers from canonical sources and prove the existing app-field verification gates as trustworthy exact-SHA signals.
truthOwner: Canonical OpenAPI sources/composer own generated-client truth; app-field package scripts own local verification entry points.

tasks.objective: Establish a clean reproducible verification baseline before product writes.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical results are stale and contract generation can block all downstream evidence; a fake-green workaround would invalidate closure.
tasks.requiredChange: Reproduce current materialization/install/gates on A, isolate any failing schema/$ref/composer owner, repair it at source, regenerate and add focused regression evidence.
tasks.targetState: Frozen install/OpenAPI materialization and app-field typecheck/lint/test/build are deterministic and fail correctly on real defects.
tasks.action: Fetch latest A, run contract generation/install/app-field gates, trace root causes only when reproduced, fix canonical inputs, regenerate, rerun and record exact SHA.
mustNotChange: لا تعديل unrelated workflows للحصول على green.
لا اعتماد نتيجة من BB أو SHA تاريخي.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI materialization exits zero from clean source.
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile reaches completion when required.
app-field typecheck/lint/test/build pass on the same candidate.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix contract generation; never rollback by bypassing a gate.
tasks.commitBoundary: Verification foundation only after reproducible evidence.
